core_infrastructure.description: Shared infrastructure. Not F-slices. No commit tag ownership. Zero business logic.
modules: src/core/types/primitives.ts — Shared types and ID generation

exceptions.F-design-system: Pure token/component library. No app/ or exec/ — no server ops, no DB, no events.
exceptions.F-dashboard: Composition root and render surface owner. No server ops, no DB, no events — no exec/ needed. Orchestrates F-intake, F-planner, F-output hooks. providers.tsx lives here.
exceptions.F-intake: Client-only intake form. No server ops beyond calling F-planner/F-project contracts.
exceptions.F-output: Client hook + server contracts delegated to output-workflow. exec/ lives in workflow/.

completeness.description: A complete feature slice requires domain logic, contract boundary, and execution/I/O.
